notes.title: SurviBall 1.1.0 Version notes
notes.content:
[b]🍭 Sweet Adventures Update – New Zone, Tournament Activation & Bug Fixes 🎮[/b]

Hello, players! 🎉
We’re back with a delightful new update packed with fresh content, tournament activation, and some essential fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Let’s dive into the details:

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes[/b]

🍬 Candy-Themed Zone
[list]
[*]New Zone Added: Embark on a sugary adventure with the newly added candy-themed zone!

– LQ Games 🎮

notes.title: SurviBall 1.0.9 Version notes
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Update Live – Infinite Mode Enhancements & Tournament Adjustments 🎮[/b]
Hello, players! 🎉
We’re thrilled to share a fresh update packed with improvements, adjustments, and exciting news about the upcoming tournament. As always, your feedback helps us shape the game into something even better. Here’s what’s new in this version:

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes[/b]

[b]🌌 Infinite Mode Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Gameplay Adjustments: Refined gameplay balance for a smoother experience.
[*]New Skin Selection: You can now change your skin while playing Infinite Mode. Customize your look and play in style!
[*]Damage Cooldown: Added a cooldown to damage mechanics for improved pacing and fairness.
[*]Achievement Updates: Adjustments made to Infinite Mode achievements to ensure better progression and rewards.
[*]🎮 User Interface Updates
New Options Menu: Infinite Mode now features its own dedicated options menu for tailored settings.
Minor UI Adjustments: Improved the overall interface for a cleaner, more user-friendly experience.
Menu Bug Fixes: Fixed an issue where menus would overlap incorrectly.
[*]🚫 Exploit Fixes
Resolved an exploit that allowed players to move backward in Infinite Mode.
[*]⚔️ Gameplay Polishing
Fine-tuned several hitboxes for more accurate collision detection and gameplay.
[/list]
[b]🏆 Tournament Details Update[/b]
[list]
[*]Date Change: The tournament will now run from 11/01/2025 at 1 PM PST to 13/01/2025 at 1 PM PST.
[*]Prepare to Compete: All tournament rules and rewards remain the same, so get ready to showcase your skills!
[/list]
[b]🚀 Looking Ahead[/b]
We’re continually improving Infinite Mode and other parts of the game. With this update, we’re setting the stage for an incredible tournament and an even better gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates and surprises in 2025!

Thank you for being an amazing part of our community.

– LQ Games 🎮

notes.title: SurviBall 1.0.8 Version notes
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Update Live – New Fixes, Features & Tournament Details 🎮[/b]

Hello, players! 🎉
We’re excited to kick off 2025 with a fresh update filled with fixes, new features, and exciting details about our upcoming tournament. Thanks to your continued feedback, we’re making the game better with every update. Here’s what’s new in this version:

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes[/b]

🛡️ Exploit Fixes

Fixed an exploit that allowed players to use the catapult infinitely in mid-air.
🔄 Respawn Message Fix

Resolved an issue where the respawn message would appear at incorrect times.
🏆 New Achievements Added

Infinite Mode now has additional achievements for you to unlock. Keep pushing your limits!
🌍 Text Translation Completed

All previously untranslated texts have now been localized for a better global experience.
🖱️ Minor Cursor Bug Fixes

Smoothed out some minor bugs with cursor behavior for a more polished experience.
🎯 Tournament Rules & Special Map

Tournament rules and rewards for the 13/01/2025–14/01/2025 event have been added! The tournament will take place on a special map designed just for this event. Compete for amazing prizes and show off your skills!

[b]🚀 Looking Ahead[/b]
This update is just the beginning of an exciting year for our game. With your support, we’re committed to delivering more features, events, and surprises in 2025.

🎉 Join the Fun
Dive into the new content, and don’t forget to prepare for the tournament—it’s going to be legendary! Thank you for being part of our incredible community.

– LQ Games 🎮

notes.title: SurviBall 1.0.3 Version notes
notes.content:
[b]📢 Update Live – Bug Fixes, Features & Improvements 📢[/b]

Hello, players! 🎮
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for our game, packed with bug fixes, new features, and enhancements to make your experience even better. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it’s what drives us to keep improving. Let’s dive into the details!

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/b]

🔧 Player Orientation Fix

Resolved an issue causing players to spawn facing the wrong direction (to the right) in Zone 2 maps.
🎯 Replay Levels with Ease

Added a "Restart Level" button after completing a level. Perfect for those chasing leaderboard perfection!
🏆 New Hidden Achievement

A mysterious achievement has been added—can you uncover it? 👀
🌍 Map Adjustments: Zone 3, Map 5

Significant changes to Map 5 in Zone 3. To ensure fairness, leaderboard times for this map have been reset. While we aim to avoid leaderboard resets, this was necessary due to the incomplete state of the previous version.
🎨 Visual Upgrades: Zone 2

Enhanced aesthetics for Zone 2 to make the area even more immersive.
🖥️ UI & Scaling Improvements

Fixed various UI and scaling bugs to improve visuals across different resolutions.
🏅 Achievements Overhaul

Updated visuals for achievements with brand-new artwork—collect them all to see the stunning designs!
🚀 Faster Game Startup

Optimized the game’s startup process, significantly reducing loading times for a smoother experience.

[b]🚀 What’s Next?[/b]
We’re actively working on more updates, with plans to bring even more features, quality-of-life changes, and bug fixes. Stay tuned for frequent patches over the coming weeks.

Your feedback and suggestions continue to be vital, so please share your thoughts with us. Together, we’re shaping this game into something extraordinary! ❤️

Enjoy the update and keep on gaming!
– LQ Games 🎮

notes.title: SurviBall 1.0.2 Version notes
notes.content:
[b]📢 Update Live – Optimizations & Improvements 📢[/b]

Hi everyone! 🎮
We’re thrilled to share a new update for our game that brings important optimizations, improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, and we’re continuing our commitment to frequent updates over the next month, including multiple patches each week when necessary.

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/b]
⚙️ Optimized GPU Usage: Reduced GPU consumption for smoother performance on a wider range of systems.
🔧 Level Selection: Improved UI and functionality to make selecting levels more intuitive and convenient.
🎨 Enhanced Visual Clarity: Improved image sharpness for a more polished experience.
🕹️ Pause Menu Options: Added an in-game settings menu accessible from the pause menu.
🎵 Music Volume Fixes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the music volume settings from saving properly.
Resolved an issue where opening the options panel would mute the music unexpectedly.

[b]🚀 What’s Next?[/b]
We’re hard at work on even more updates to improve the game and bring new features. Over the next month, you can expect frequent updates addressing bugs, adding quality-of-life improvements, and introducing exciting new features.

Your reviews and suggestions are what drive these improvements, so please keep sharing your thoughts. Together, we’re making this game better with every update! ❤️

Enjoy the update and stay tuned for more!
– LQ Games 🎮
